They say good things come in small packages, and when it comes to blind boxes, I absolutely agree. Blind boxes contain collectible merch, usually figurines (but sometimes, other fun things as well — more on that below), that remain unknown to the recipient until they open it. Not only are they fun to collect, they’re also great gifts — each box has a surprise inside, making what might be a stressful gifting process enjoyable for everyone involved.
Below, I compiled a range of mystery-filled options that’ll delight anyone in your life, whether they’re a dedicated collector or a total blind box newbie.

Below, I rounded up the best blind box gifts for kids, adults and everyone in between. To make this list, I searched for popular and top-rated blind boxes from across the web, along with some NBC Selected staff favorites from our resident blind box lovers.
Kodak Charmera Blind Box Digital Camera Keychain
Digital cameras are everywhere these days — including in blind boxes. This box from Kodak houses one of seven small digital cameras that can actually take photos and record videos. Your giftee can customize the photos on the camera with Kodak’s frames, filters and date stamps (for a vintage look), plus the camera includes a USB-C cable for fast and easy charging and file transfer. The images are square and have a high-quality output, so it’s ideal for your giftee to snap memories while on the go. It also doubles as a bag charm, making it an easy-to-carry camera that doubles as a cool accessory.
These adorable blind box figures come in a wide range of colorful, expressive series that are great for decorating your home or office space. The Angels come in a variety of collectible series, including collections with themes like flowers, fruits, animals, sweets and more . This edition features 12 dolls, all of which are wearing a different kind of veggie-themed headgear. These figures can be purchased individually, or in an assorted box containing 12 blind boxes.
Disney Wishables Star Wars Day Shimmer Plushes
Even if your giftee isn’t a Star Wars fan, they’ll love these adorable plushies from Disney. They can get one of five Star Wars Bounty Hunter characters in the box, including Din Djarin, Boba Fett, Fennec Shand and more. Each plushie also includes glittery, shimmery details, as a way to celebrate Star Wars Day (May 4).
Not only are the contents of this Miffy blind box adorable, they’re great for any imaginative or playful giftees on your list. Each box has a piece of furniture and other household accessories that they can use to fill and decorate Miffy’s space. They can rearrange decor, put clothes up to hang, tuck Miffy into bed or even sit her down for a meal — it’s all up to their imagination (and what comes inside of their box).
Give the gift of winter cheer with this holiday-themed blind box from Smoko. This collection includes fan-favorite characters like Pearl Boba, Tayto Potato, Sloan Sloth and Lil B Dumpling dressed up in winter and holiday gear. Each figure is made from high-quality vinyl, according to the brand.
Former NBC Selected editorial projects manager Rebecca Rodriguez is a huge blind box fan, and loves the design of the Peach Riot figurines. “My friend gave me three of these for my birthday this year because I have a figurine obsession and I loved them so much I bought two more from the Punk Fairy series,” she says. This series has a total of 12 figurines showing the characters playing music, writing, surfing the web and more, with one secret edition hidden in a few special boxes.
Starface x Hello Kitty Big Mystery Compact
Starface makes some of our favorite (and cutest) pimple patches , and this Hello Kitty collaboration adds a fun, mystery box twist to the formula we know and love. When your giftee opens the box, they’ll receive one of four special Hello Kitty compacts, which include a built-in mirror and 32 acne-fighting hydrocolloid patches in different Hello Kitty-themed designs. I’ve always found Starface’s compacts to be an easy, lightweight way for me to make sure I can treat pimples on the go, or switch out patches I’m already wearing. Plus, the brand’s designs are a cute step-up from the traditional, transparent pimple patches your giftee may be used to.
Smoko Winter Wonderland Plush Keychain Blind Box
These festive figurines are an ideal choice for any blind box lovers on your list who love winter weather. Inside, they’ll get one of Smoko’s adorable characters in cozy, cold-weather clothing like scarves, hats and even snowman suits. Each character also comes on a keychain, so your giftee can carry their new plush with them everywhere they go.
This blind box combines cuteness and functionality to make the perfect desk accessory for your loved one. Each box contains a Miffy figurine that doubles as an adjustable phone and tablet stand. To adjust the stand, you simply move Miffy’s legs to the desired length, lean your device against her upper body and head, and you’re all set.
Perfect for the foodie on your list, these vinyl figurines from Smoko will add a fun, food-themed element to any blind box collection. Inside, you’ll find Smoko’s signature Tayto Payto character in one of five ramen-themed outfits, including fish cakes, noodles and shrimp. Although blind box figures usually go well on desks or shelves, this culinary collection also makes a great addition to any kitchen.
Plants make excellent gifts because they double as both decor and a household hobby. If your giftee isn’t a traditional blind box fan, this plant mystery box from Rooted is a great alternative. Each mystery box includes three baby mystery plants that they can tend to and grow, and are available with and without planters. If your giftee doesn’t have much of a green thumb, each included plant is low-maintenance and requires watering only once a week, according to the brand.
Squishmallows Kellytoy Plush Mystery Pack
look great on my bed, but they also work great as extra back or neck support when I’m reading or working on my computer. This mystery pack has three assorted, 8-inch Squishmallows in each pack, including character options like Shelia Chocolate Pancakes and Charles Green Pickle. With this box, you can give your giftee three plushies for the price of one, along with a cozy accessory that’s sure to help enhance their sleep experience.
Pop Mart Hirono The Other One Blind Box Figures
Hirono figures are meant to show the subtle emotions we experience from life’s ups and downs in a fun, creative way. In this collection, little Hirono is featured in 12 different versions, including animal outfits, pajamas and costumes. The series also includes a special secret-edition figurine that your loved one has a 1/144 chance of receiving, according to the brand.
Skullpanda figurines are all about personality and expression, and this collection series is no different. The series includes the pale-colored figurines trying to stay warm through activities like doodling, wandering, chirping with birds and walking on a rainy day. Each figurine is between 2 to 3.5 inches (depending on the figurine’s design), and is made from a shiny, non-toxic PVC plastic, according to the brand.
Crave Japan Mystery Drinks And Snacks Crate
World Market offers treats and snacks from around the globe, and this mystery box is designed to give your loved one a taste of Japan from the comfort of their own home. The mystery box includes between 15 to 18 Japanese snacks, drinks and treats for them to sample, including sodas, chips, candy and cookies. The boxes are also available in different versions, including a Hello Kitty box, a Naruto box and a Mexican sweets mystery box.
Studio Ghibli’s films and characters are beloved by adults and kids alike, which is why this mystery bag is a great pick for everyone of all ages. Inside the bag, your giftee will find a unique assortment of Japan-exclusive Ghibli-themed collectibles, including cards, puzzles, stationary and toys. Home and kitchen decor items like reusable containers and towels are also included, so your giftee can add a Studio Ghibli touch to their personal space as well. The mystery bag is also available for fans of other franchises, including Sanrio , Kirby and Jujutsu Kaisen .
Kewpie dolls are a classic toy, and this blind box has one of six classic, playful Kewpie poses. The figures are about 3 inches in height and are made from a vinyl material that’s easy to clean with a soft cloth, according to the brand. These designs are especially great for avid blind box collectors who’ll love the chance to add figurines of this classic character for their collections.
Popmart Crybaby x Powerpuff Girls Figures
If your giftee enjoys the Crybaby blind box collections, they’ll love this special Powerpuff Girls edition. Not only can they receive Crybaby versions of their favorite Powerpuff getting ready for bed, but they can also get characters like Professor X, the Mayor and Mojo Jojo. The collection has 12 figurines in total, three of which include a special Powerpuff bunny suit made from long plush material.
Smiski Glow in the Dark Yoga Series Figure
Smiski collectibles are known for their unique green design and wide range of movements and poses. In this series, Smiski practices yoga, making these the ideal calming addition to your giftee’s collection. Each Smiski box will have one of six varying designs, and are made from a phosphorescent material that allows them to glow in the dark.
Each of these blind boxes has one of twelve figures, which are designed to show different emotions of the minion Bob from the Despicable Me series, according to the brand. They’re great for desk decor, car ornaments, party favors and more. They have a round, tumbler design so that they never topple over, and you also have a 1/144 chance of getting a hidden secret edition figure.
Each blind box in this series contains one of the adorable Monsters characters, each in a different yoga pose. The collection contains ten figures, all of which are designed to express movement and emotions, according to the brand The figures all stand between two and five inches tall, and come with a yoga mat-style base.
